Seru Company · Operating playbook

Sales → Implementation journey

One path from a Bangalore lead to a live tenant. Humans close and decide; Seru bots prepare data, drafts, costs, and go-live — never promise a custom build, only a tenant on the live stack.

Proof live VP Culture Club + console modules Go-live floor ~1 day ops Promo month-1 SaaS free · cap 20 / 60 days

Humans

Owner / sales calls, approve-send, commercial yes/no, go-live sign-off, money decisions.

Seru bots

Data, drafts, pricing truth, cost stamps, digests, go-live checklist, tenant seed helpers.

Shared rule

Soft card only. No GMV cut. Venue Razorpay → their settlement. Digests only on real delta.

At a glance

1 · Lead→ 2 · Queue→ 3 · Pitch→ 4 · Won→ 5 · Seed→ 6 · Go-live→ 7 · Live
01

Lead intake

Data Guy Owner review

Verified Bangalore venues only — never invented contacts.

  • Score fit, commerce signal, primary/secondary bundle.
  • Stamp soft-card SKU + list INR + founding flag + go-live fee.
  • Export dashboard CSV (quoted fields) for import.
Hand-off: bangalore-dashboard-import.csv → Salesman.
02

Sales queue & drafts

Salesman Developer Owner Mac

Utilities sales dashboard on the owner Mac (LAN: http://192.168.1.8:5174).

  • Import CSV → pipeline with soft-card prices from /api/prices.
  • Drafts get free-month line + SKU; founding left off until Ops flips gate.
  • No real approve-send until mail is connected.
Gate: drafts OK · sends blocked until mail greenlight.
03

Pitch & pre-sales

You / sales call Salesman Finance Guy

Human conversation; bots keep the commercial truth consistent.

  • Demo = live VP Culture Club + console modules on/off — not a static mock.
  • Promise: tenant cut from live stack — never custom build.
  • Quote soft card only (Complete ₹4,999 · singles ₹2,499 · Tickets ₹1,999 · add-ons ₹999).
  • Pitch: “First month SaaS on us” (SKU only) · go-live ₹9,999 on singles · Complete annual waives go-live.
Promo lock: free month-1 SaaS · cap first 20 Bangalore go-lives / 60 days · no free+founding stack · founding (when unlocked) starts month 2.
04

Won → handoff

Owner marks won Salesman ImpOps Finance

Mark won in the dashboard — seeds the go-live packet.

  • Capture: bundle, domain, razorpay_ready, SKU, list INR, go-live fee, month-1 waived.
  • Finance checks soft-card + go-live / founding warnings.
  • ImpOps ticks promo count (20 / 60-day) and opens go-live checklist.
Rule: won without seed fields = incomplete handoff. Don’t start go-live blind.
05

Tenant seed

ImpOps Console (you) Dev = utilities only

Create the client on the live Seru stack — shared SPA/API, hostname → tenant.

  • Create client → package / modules / UI pack.
  • Site Studio + Media Manager for brand surface.
  • Domain / DNS path (Cloudflare Free OK).
Code lock: only Seru Developer writes code, and only in seru-team-utilities — not seru-app.
06

Go-live (~1 day)

ImpOps Venue staff + you

Ops floor is about one day — same checklist for every tenant.

  • Venue Razorpay keys + settlement story (their money, no GMV cut).
  • Staff logins for /admin; Seru platform ops use /console.
  • Smoke each sold module (events / classes / tickets / finance / …).
  • Public site + member portal check; mark live.
Fees: go-live ₹9,999 on first single module · waived on Complete annual · month-1 SaaS ₹0 under promo.
07

Live · bill · watch

Finance Ops Exec ImpOps digests Owner

Running tenant on shared infra — cost is mostly fixed, not per-client Run/SQL.

  • Dashboard: mark paid / suspend as needed.
  • Ops Exec: unit cost + founding gate (/api/ops) after LB cutover or ≥2 live tenants.
  • ImpOps weekday digests: Locked / Blocked / Next — only when something changed.
Infra truth: free month-1 doesn’t move GCP much; risk is go-live labor + deferred SaaS, not servers.

Soft card (quote only this)

  • Complete — ₹4,999/mo
  • Events or Classes + Site — ₹2,499
  • Tickets & Scan — ₹1,999
  • Finance / Loyalty / CMS — ₹999 each
  • Go-live — ₹9,999 (singles) · waived Complete annual

Founding (closed for now)

₹3,999×12 Complete or ₹1,499×3 singles — flagged until LB cutover or ≥2 live tenants. When unlocked, rate starts month 2 (after free month-1).

Who to ping

  • Leads → Data Guy
  • Pitch / drafts → Salesman + Finance
  • Dashboard bugs → Developer (utilities)
  • Won → ImpOps go-live
  • ₹/tenant → Ops Exec

Example path (Abhinava-shaped)

Lead stamped Complete ₹4,999 → draft with free month-1 → call on live demo → won + seed → ImpOps 1-day go-live (go-live fee waived on Complete annual) → live · promo tick 1/20.
